layouts.name: Driftland
layouts.description: Combined mapped configurations: Inner S course, Cross-course alternative. Shared sections count once in the mapped branch length. Branch identity and historical alignment still need review.

layouts.name: Inner S course
layouts.description: The operator identifies multiple configurable courses suitable for clockwise and counter-clockwise use. The supplied configuration image depicts the western oval and shortcut, the inner S and the eastern perimeter. Exact pinned public nodes preserve all independently mapped branches of that physical footprint, excluding the neighboring Lochgelly oval. This descriptive course name does not claim an official configuration name; the exact historical timed branch choice remains draft. This complementary circuit retains the inner S.
